title: Damian Woody has drastic Brendan Sorsby warning for NFL teams: ‘Cardinal sin’

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Damian Woody has drastic Brendan Sorsby warning for NFL teams: ‘Cardinal sin’
sources.description: Quarterback-needy NFL teams are beginning to do their homework on Brendan Sorsby, but ex-Jet Damian Woody is sending a warning to all prospective teams.
